title: Open and closed pieces of smooth proper schemes
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $Y$ be a smooth proper scheme over $K$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] [def-weil-proper-morphism]. If $Z\subseteq Y$ is a nonempty open-and-closed subscheme, then $Z$ is smooth and proper over $K$.
